title: Online Assessment: Completing a Small LLM Inference Engine
summary: Complete a small vLLM-style LLM serving engine across five gated levels, working from given, sparsely commented toy-model, block-allocator, sequence and request-queue code: admission and prefill, a budget-constrained decode scheduler, stop conditions and block freeing, hash-keyed prefix caching with LRU eviction, and preemption once the block pool runs out.
